svg.title: 03 / Review CSV interpretation before adoption
svg.desc: Essential workbench concept 03. A live session stays untouched while proposed CSV import settings and a bounded token preview sit in the tools pane: delimiter and header intent, detected versus proposed types, a zero-padded identifier kept as text. EW-03D design only. Static drawing, synthetic data, not a runtime screenshot.
svg.text: STATIC CONCEPT • synthetic data • not a runtime screenshot
The candidate is described before it is adopted: delimiter, header, detected-versus-proposed types, bounded tokens.
no importer, no settings API and no adoption path is implemented or approved

g.text: detected from the sample, not applied

text.tspan: Unavailable until capability, coverage and
source ownership are resolved — no promise
is made here.

g.text: held as text, not a number
Live session grid and Record are unchanged: no candidate rows, no import overlay, no replacement.
Synthetic sample — cells are illustrations, not a fixture.
row 3 · id 0003 · name Cedar Hollow · status needs review · amount 7.25
The pending CSV candidate is described in the tools pane; it is not this dataset and never enters this grid before adoption.

text.tspan: Change the delimiter, the header or a type
and every earlier preview becomes stale. A
stale preview can never be adopted.
The preview must be requested again, and the
request must show what it used.
No auto-recompute and no silent re-sniff.
A row beyond the sample fails the proposed
conversion, so the whole adoption is
refused and the live session stays.
count(*) is not proof that every column converted;
the complete typed check is the acceptance
question.
Parse-time text is kept: a cast back cannot
restore “0017”.
If the browser reader does not expose the
option, the control is absent or disabled
with the reason stated.
The plain open path stays available and is not
turned into a settings wizard.
Reader 1.4.3 must be probed in the browser;
CLI inference is not evidence.
Abandoning or failing the preview keeps the
live session, its history, findings and
Record selection.
Whether an already-registered source is owned,
released or left until teardown is undecided (ADR
0047 has no release API).
No Cancel control is drawn: this board is a
preview review, not the WF-06 opening
state.

svg.text: 1 Probe the browser WASM reader → 2 Settle source ownership and the complete-check meaning → 3 Accept a decision ledger → 4 Separately approved EW-03I brief

text.tspan: Owner: maintainer. Delimiter, header and duplicate-or-empty names · all-text versus typed columns · date formats · quoted empty versus NULL · sample disclosure · the definition of a complete check · adoption
identity · cancel and resource bounds · registration reuse versus a separately approved lifecycle change.

Parse-time text preservation cannot be recovered by a later cast · repeated option previews must not create registered tables · a successful count is not exhaustive conversion proof · recommendations are not
accepted defaults. Format expansion (.ndjson, Arrow, XLSX) and any error-skipping policy are outside this drawing.

svg.text: Tasks / specification: docs/product/16-essential-workbench-first-wave-spec.md §5 (EW-03D) · ADRs 0012 (immutable source), 0029/0030 (SQL), 0047 (table retention) · ADR 0044 (shell).

Synthetic data only · the pane is a proposed settings concept, not approved UI · detected values are a header/sample sniff, not a complete typed check · no runtime, reader-version or performance evidence claimed.
